system.description:
Accountants keep track of expenses, income, stocks and taxes. This skill is primarily used to recover taxed Resources.

Obstacles: Calculating taxes for a single income, single residence individual, Ob 1. Maintaining simple personal finances, Ob 2. Maintaining a family’s income, Ob 3. A small business’ books, Ob 4. An estate’s books, Ob 5. A large business’ books, Ob 6. A town’s books, Ob 7. A city’s books, Ob 8. A province’s books, Ob 9. A nation’s books, Ob 10.

FoRKs: Research, Reading, Administration, Estate Management

Skill Type: Academic. Tools: Yes.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 253
